digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text cutover and echo suppression
propositions: State-based echo suppression keyed on sha256 digest of rendered wire (rich_sha) and reemit counter prevents unbounded loops when codec is lossy and decode(encode(x)) != x
DC WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound must compose decode(to_wire) to restore codec law; Cloud AdfCodec must point to markdown_to_adf/adf_to_markdown; both converge in one pass when unchanged
Two distinct compare operations must apply: emit-side uses plain inbound-decoded remote vs normalized local fit; baseline-side uses decode(baseline_wire) vs local routed through normalize_outbound

DC has two create paths (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _issues._translate_create_fields) that both must compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) or CREATE ships unrendered Markdown while UPDATE ships rendered wiki
With cutover flag off (default), plain identity wire is byte-identical to pre-cutover behavior; in install without marklas extra, functions degrade to plain-text fallback
One post-push GET via apply_handlers.handle_update at rich_reemit counter == 2 reads back observed value and overlays to baseline without writing it; _advance_baselines remains sole baseline writer
